final: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT c.SupportRepId AS support_rep_id, e.City AS employee_city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer AS c JOIN Employee AS e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY c.SupportRepId, e.City), city_averages AS (SELECT employee_city, AVG(customer_count) AS average_count FROM rep_counts GROUP BY employee_city), joined AS (SELECT r.support_rep_id, r.employee_city, r.customer_count, r.customer_count * 1.0 / a.average_count AS city_ratio FROM rep_counts AS r JOIN city_averages AS a ON CAST(r.employee_city AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY = CAST(a.employee_city AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY), overall AS (SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS total_count FROM joined) SELECT j.support_rep_id, j.employee_city, j.customer_count, j.city_ratio, j.customer_count * 1.0 / o.total_count AS overall_ratio FROM joined AS j CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY overall_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
